stem: The macromolecule RNA is common to all living beings, and DNA, which is found in all organisms except some bacteria, is almost as ____.

Argument may be an overly (i)____ word to apply to the gossamer contrivance that is A Summer of Humming birds. In what seems a self-conscious (ii)____ of its mascot the book flits from one subject or moment in history to another, following the various whims of its author.

So (i)____ is the reputation of the country's police for corruption and other forms of (ii)____ that it has become a kind of tradition that every newly appointed police chief pledges to (iii)____ the force.
Although the parents do not think highly of the educational system “as a whole”, they fail to treat teachers with ____ equally.
Economic growth has been identified as a ____ for poor countries to eradicate poverty, but this prescription also triggers great environmental concerns.

In mathematics, judgments about the validity of proofs are mediated by peer-reviewed journals; to ensure ____, reviewers are carefully chosen by journal editors, and the identity of scholars whose papers are under consideration are kept secret.

The sociologist argued that criminal behavior is an impermanent condition because it is the result of cyclical forces operating through ____ factors, not the manifestation of deeply rooted personal characteristics.
